correctness.rationale: Stationary joint gamma–Gaussian representation solves the two generator transform equations and yields all polynomial moments and exponential positional tails. Statewise Poisson corrector \(h_0(x)=kx^2/2\), \(h_1=-kD/(2q)\) satisfies \(\mathcal Lh=c-g\). Its bounded jumps and exact quadratic-variation formula give the rate \(2D^2k+9D^2k^2/(4q)\) and the martingale CLT after a stationary \(L^2\)-bounded boundary correction. One-switch stationary events give infinite positive and negative exponential moments for every \(T>0\). Four exact rational checks, eighteen transform identities, and three independent-switching simulations passed, though numerics are non-proofs.

value.rationale: This is a physically natural path-dependent energy-input observable in the foundational stochastic on/off harmonic model, not an arbitrary numerical slice. The previously known switching-rate-independent mean hides a rigorously quantified slow-switching fluctuation divergence and fast-switching noise floor. The exact CLT alongside universal nonexistence of finite work exponential moments identifies a meaningful boundary between central-limit fluctuation analysis and standard exponentially tilted large-deviation methods.
